plan.title: Growth plan
plan.desc: Goals and weekly work for 90 days: set targets, record where you start, work through keywords, competitors, content and links in phases, and check Google data and inquiries on day 30, 60 and 90 to adjust.
plan.draft_desc: AI reads your company and product info, your site's current Google data, keywords and competitors, decides which phase to start from, offers conservative, normal and aggressive targets, and plans the first weeks. Then you pick a level here and start.
plan.req_hint: Used every time a plan is drafted: how to set targets, how many tasks a week, what to focus on.
plan.empty_desc: The tools are here; what's missing is direction: what to reach in 90 days, what to do each week and whether it worked. Have AI draft one from your site's current data.
plan.phase_hint_1: Keyword map, competitor analysis, site fixes, core pages, first links
plan.phase_hint_2: Strengthen quick wins, rewrite titles, more topics, social posts with links
plan.phase_hint_3: Landing pages and inquiry forms, refresh declining pages, inquiry sources
plan.stage_suggest: Based on current data, start from "{phase}".
plan.draft_notice: AI has drafted the plan. Review the approach and the three levels, pick one and click Start: today's numbers are saved as the baseline every checkpoint compares against. To change anything, use Continue chat at the top right.
plan.pick_level: Pick a target level (numbers to reach in 90 days)
plan.cp_due_desc: AI compares Google impressions, clicks, rankings and inquiries with the baseline, writes conclusions and plans the next phase week by week.
plan.cp_due_desc_final: AI reviews the full 90 days: how far each target got, what worked best, and what to do in the next 90 days.
plan.tier_process_hint: Articles published, keywords targeted: fully in your hands
plan.tier_leading_hint: Google impressions, rankings, AI recommendations: move weeks before inquiries
plan.not_connected: No data yet (counts once Google data is connected)
plan.first_weeks: Weekly work for the first phase
plan.card_none_desc: Have AI set targets from your current data and plan the weekly work, with checks on day 30, 60 and 90.
plan.card_draft: Your growth plan needs a target level
plan.card_draft_desc: AI has drafted it; pick a level to start.
plan.map_desc: Keywords grouped by topic, one page per topic. See how far each topic has got, its Google impressions and clicks, and the inquiries it brought; click Do it to take the next step.
plan.map_empty: No screened keyword topics yet. Find keywords under Google rankings → Keywords and have AI screen and cluster them.
plan.map_note: Impressions and clicks are Google's last 28 days; inquiries count the page the form was submitted on.
plan.map_note_since: Impressions and clicks are Google's last 28 days; inquiries were submitted on the page since the plan started ({date}).
plan.links_desc: Backlinks are links on other sites pointing to yours. Links on social profiles and posts are mostly nofollow: little direct ranking help, but they bring visits and help Google find new pages. Links from industry directories, B2B storefronts, industry sites and media are what move rankings.
plan.lk_directory_sub: Associations, yellow pages, trade show lists
plan.links_empty: No backlinks yet. Social posts that link to your site are added with "Add from social posts"; record B2B storefronts and directory listings with "Add a backlink". They are checked weekly.
plan.lf_source_hint: e.g. your B2B storefront or your company's page on a directory
plan.lf_target: Which page of your site it links to
plan.map_page_pos_hint: Average rank of the page across all queries, not just this topic
plan.auto_hint: marked automatically from your data; AI marks what it does
